data_structures.title: Data Structures & Algorithms
data_structures.description: Master fundamental data structures and algorithm design techniques. Covers arrays, linked lists, trees, graphs, dynamic programming, and more.
data_structures.description_cn: 系统掌握数据结构与算法核心知识，覆盖线性结构、树图、动态规划、排序搜索等 20 个递进式知识点。

operating_systems.title: Operating Systems
operating_systems.description: Learn OS fundamentals: process management, memory management, file systems, and concurrency.
operating_systems.description_cn: 深入学习操作系统核心原理：进程调度、内存管理、文件系统与并发控制。

computer_networks.title: Computer Networks
computer_networks.description: Understand TCP/IP, HTTP, DNS, routing, and network security from the ground up.
computer_networks.description_cn: 从物理层到应用层，系统掌握 TCP/IP 协议栈、路由算法与网络安全基础。

machine_learning.title: Machine Learning Foundations
machine_learning.description: Introduction to ML: supervised & unsupervised learning, neural networks, and model evaluation.
machine_learning.description_cn: 入门机器学习：监督与无监督学习、神经网络、模型评估与特征工程。

python_programming.title: Python Programming
python_programming.description: From basics to advanced: Python syntax, OOP, functional programming, and common libraries.
python_programming.description_cn: 从基础语法到高级特性，涵盖面向对象、函数式编程、常用标准库与第三方库。
